name: Takajou Yuna
source:
Despite being a member of the dropout group, she is well liked by those around her. She is liked because of who she is and not her abilities. She was placed in the "special" classroom because of her unknown potential ability.

Even though she in this classroom, she maintains a positive attitude. During the protagonist's training practicum, her friendly and comforting presence helped him get used to his new role. Her very presence makes the classroom a better place to be.


The protagonist gradually becomes attracted to her and becomes a object of romantic interest. However, it is not clear if it because of her unknown P/A. Just like the protagonist, her parents passed away when she was young and is currently raised by non blood-related parents.

She is pure, sincere, caring, high achiever, and pretty. From a man's point of view, she has perfect looks and personality. She is a symbol of envy from the girls, and she never shows her weak side.

P/A: Connection

Hobbies: Cooking, reading, studying
Special Skill: Tennis talent
Likes: Sweet things, cute things, four leaf clovers
Dislikes: Bitter things, spicy things.

[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/PA/top.html]official site[/url]]
